notes: Group G: Science & Technology (DST/DBT/DSIR-CSIR), Earth Sciences, MeitY, Information & Broadcasting, Environment/Forest/Climate Change, Culture, Tourism, Textiles, Youth Affairs & Sports, DoNER. WebSearch quota was exhausted partway through this research pass (shared session-wide budget); remaining facts were sourced via WebFetch against Wikipedia and official .gov.in pages, and via curl against the Wikipedia parse API (curl was rate-limited/429 for most of the pass, likely from concurrent sibling research agents sharing the same egress IP, so WebFetch was the primary tool). KNOWN GAPS (all flagged confidence medium/low and/or noted inline on the entity): ANRF CEO name unconfirmed; DPDP Board of India constitution/chairperson status unconfirmed (Act provisions notified 2025-11-13 but operational status as of 2026-09-25 unverified); CAQM chairperson unconfirmed; NTCA and CZA member-secretary names unconfirmed; BSI director name unconfirmed; PIB Principal DG name unconfirmed; NFDC Managing Director unconfirmed (a 2026 Chairman appointment reported in one source but not independently corroborated); IGNCA member secretary unconfirmed; NIXI CEO name unconfirmed; several small bodies (NeGD, STQC, NIELIT, Central Silk Board, Textiles Committee, DC-Handlooms, DC-Handicrafts, NDTL, LNIPE, NEDFi, NEHHDC, FRI, IIFM, National Library-adjacent museums) are included on general knowledge of their existence/mandate/parent but their current office-holders were not verified against a live 2025-2026 source this pass -- confidence set to low/medium and holder name omitted or left unconfirmed accordingly, per the 'never invent' rule. IndiaAI Mission and India Semiconductor Mission budget figures are reported inconsistently across sources; only the July 2026 Semicon 2.0 Cabinet approval figure (Rs 1,27,500 crore) is included, without a fiscal-year breakdown. CSIR lab count is commonly cited as 37-39 depending on source/year; used 37 with a note. NSFs and DST/DBT institute aggregates are placeholders (not exhaustively itemised) except DBT's 9 named institutes, which are itemised individually.

entities.name: Ministry of Science and Technology

entities.name: Textiles Committee

entities.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
entities.description: Umbrella ministry of two departments — Youth Affairs and Sports — covering youth-development programmes (e.g. NYKS, National Service Scheme), elite sport promotion, sports infrastructure and anti-doping regulation.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Youth Affairs
entities.description: Runs national youth-development and volunteering programmes — Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS), National Service Scheme (NSS), and youth-leadership schemes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Sports
entities.description: Formulates national sports policy, funds elite athlete development (Khelo India, TOPS) and oversees SAI and the anti-doping regime.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Sports Authority of India
entities.description: India's apex sports-development body, running national training centres, coaching schemes (e.g. Khelo India), sports infrastructure and talent identification.
entities.legalBasis: Registered autonomous society under Department of Sports
entities.notes: Current Director General not confirmed by an available source in this pass.

entities.name: National Anti-Doping Agency
entities.description: India's national anti-doping organisation, running dope-testing, education and results-management for Indian sport, aligned with WADA standards.
entities.legalBasis: National Anti-Doping Act, 2022

entities.name: National Dope Testing Laboratory
entities.description: WADA-accredited laboratory that analyses athlete samples for prohibited substances, operationally distinct from the regulator NADA.
entities.legalBasis: Autonomous body under Department of Sports
sources: general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass

entities.name: Laxmibai National Institute of Physical Education
entities.description: Deemed university for physical education and sports-science degrees, coach education and sports research.
entities.legalBasis: Deemed university under Department of Sports
sources: general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass

entities.name: National Sports Federations (aggregate)
entities.description: Aggregate record for the National Sports Federations (e.g. cricket, hockey, athletics, wrestling bodies) recognised by the Department of Sports to govern their respective sports and field Indian teams internationally; each NSF is an independent society, not a government body, but is regulated and (conditionally) funded by the Department.
entities.legalBasis: Recognised/regulated under the National Sports Development Code of India
entities.notes: Aggregate placeholder; individual NSFs (e.g. BCCI, which notably does not take government funding, Athletics Federation of India, Hockey India) not itemised in this pass.
sources: general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass

entities.name: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
entities.description: Coordinates and funds infrastructure, connectivity and economic-development schemes across India's eight North Eastern states, and administers the Non-Lapsable Central Pool of Resources for the region.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: North Eastern Development Finance Corporation
entities.description: Development finance institution providing term loans, venture capital and micro-finance to promote industry, infrastructure and agri-business in the North East.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (public financial institution)
sources: general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass

entities.name: North Eastern Handicrafts and Handlooms Development Corporation
entities.description: Central public sector enterprise promoting marketing, product development and welfare of handicraft and handloom artisans across the North Eastern states.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (CPSE)
sources: general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass
